column1: 23. Variations of terms and conditions of employment and disputes.–

column2: Parties hereto agree that  during  the continuance in force of this Agreement, they will not seek to vary
alter or add to any of the terms and conditions of employment, except by mutual consent.
Any  employee  enjoying  a  beneﬁt,  which  is  over  and  above  the  normal  entitlement,  shall  continue  to
enjoy the same as personal, but this beneﬁt shall not extend to any other employee. The above provision
shall not apply to the consumption of electricity, where a limit is ﬁxed for all employees.
